ios.desc:
AtLeast inverts the traditional timer. Instead of alarming when time is up, it encourages you with gentle haptic taps during your activity — and goes silent when you've done enough.

THE "AT LEAST" PHILOSOPHY
Set a minimum duration for your practice. AtLeast taps your wrist periodically as encouragement. When the silence comes, you know you've reached your goal. No intrusive alarm. No interruption. Just the rhythm stopping.

IPHONE + APPLE WATCH, TOGETHER
Pick a timer on your iPhone — it pre-loads on your watch and waits. Press Start on your Apple Watch, and your iPhone mirrors the live session at a glance. Or run a session on the iPhone itself when your watch is not with you. The watch is where you feel the taps; the iPhone is where you choose and follow along.

PERFECT FOR
- Meditation and mindfulness
- Yoga and stretching
- Cold exposure and ice baths
- Static exercises and holds
- Focused work sessions
- Breathing exercises

HOW IT WORKS
1. On your iPhone, choose a timer for your activity
2. It pre-loads on your Apple Watch — press Start there
3. Feel gentle haptic taps as encouragement; your iPhone mirrors the session
4. When the taps go silent, you've done enough
5. Keep going as long as you like — no alarm will interrupt you

SESSION TYPE AND APPLE HEALTH
Give a timer a Session Type and each finished session is saved to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes or a workout — Yoga, Flexibility, Cooldown and more. AtLeast only writes to Health; it never reads your Health data.

ATLEAST PRO
The built-in timers, Mindful Minutes and Yoga are free. AtLeast Pro adds saving your own timers, History — every finished session grouped by day, with streaks and quiet minutes — and every Session Type. Choose a monthly or annual subscription (the annual plan starts with a 7-day free trial) or a one-time AtLeast Founder purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your Apple Account settings.

PRIVACY-FIRST DESIGN
AtLeast respects your mindfulness practice:
- On-device by design — all timer logic runs locally, no network required
- Anonymous, cookieless usage statistics and crash reports — nothing personal, nothing linked to you, and you can turn them off in Settings
- No accounts — just install and use
- Your timers and History sync between your devices through your private iCloud; we cannot read them

WATCHOS-FIRST EXPERIENCE
Built for Apple Watch: eyes-free, haptic-driven, minimal distraction. The iPhone companion makes it easy to pick a timer, start on
